message: 最終下校時間
This is the last week of November. Once the weekend comes, it'll finally be December--the month of the Holy Night Festival.
I want to learn as much as I possibly can from Ria-senpai while I still have the chance, since this is her final year.
Too impatient to wait, I head straight to Class 3-A to meet her instead of going to the Student Council room.

name: Paqy
message: 「I get why you're all fired up, Synn-sama, but let's calm down a bit, yeah?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, yeah, but I'm just bursting with energy, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senp--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「How many months has it been since we all stayed behind after school like this?」

name: Ria
message: 「It feels so nostalgic.」
The third-year classroom after school.
Ria-senpai, Misasagi-senpai, and a few other upperclassmen I don't recognize are sitting in relaxed poses gathered around the desks.
The deeply sentimental tone in Ria-senpai's voice stops me in my tracks, and I end up inadvertently peeking inside from the shadow of the doorway.

name: Ria
message: 「Some of us are going to college on recommendations, while others chose to take the general entrance exams...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Some are heading to vocational school, and some are entering the workforce... Everyone's path is pretty much decided, so right now feels like one long break.」
The upperclassmen start chatting about all sorts of things.

name: Ria
message: 「I wish we could just stay behind in this classroom forever.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then... why don't we give it a try?」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, I wonder what would happen... Actually, I kinda want to try it.\s07」

name: Misasagi
message: 「As long as it's before the security guard makes their rounds, we could stay in the classroom until midnight.」

name: Ria
message: 「If we manage to dodge them well enough, maybe we could even stay up chatting until morning?」
A cherished moment of fondness spent with classmates she holds dear. Right there is a side of Ria-senpai I've never seen before.

name: Paqy
message: 「Wouldn't wanna intrude, right? Keep a lid on that eagerness for now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... that was thoughtless of me. Let's come back later.」
I quietly step away from the door.
